categories.name: mempool
categories.evidence: Lacks mempool area labels and does not modify mempool policy, validation, or internal structures; adding a count accessor in txmempool.h is solely a helper for RPC consumption.
categories.rationale: The PR does not alter mempool behavior, only adding a trivial accessor to expose count information to the RPC layer.

categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Carries RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies MempoolInfoToJSON in src/rpc/mempool.cpp to optimize getmempoolinfo.
categories.rationale: Avoids an unnecessary copy of the unbroadcast transaction ID set under lock when calling getmempoolinfo. Microbenchmarks show this reduces query time from ~0.9 ms to ~22.6 ns at 10,000 unbroadcast entries, preventing lock-held heap allocations on a frequently polled RPC.
